response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff-level engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, distributed systems and high-throughput data integration experience, and a demonstrated track record of mentoring and teaching. However, the role's core requirement — 8+ years building production-grade AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; AI-relevant work appears limited to roughly the last year at re:cinq (MCP code generators and agentic tooling). The resume shows no vector databases, RAG architectures, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), LLM evaluation/observability, or Python, and cloud exposure is mostly AWS CDK for application delivery rather than AI systems. Customer-facing technical discovery leadership is also not evidenced beyond a consulting stint. Worth a conversation if the team values a strong generalist who can be ramped into GenAI delivery, but he is not a direct match for a Staff GenAI FDE hire.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software across web, backend, mobile and embedded; genuine staff-level engineering breadth
Hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic workflow tooling experience — directly relevant to the key tech stack
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing (workshops, conference talks, courses, TDD/CI/CD craftsmanship culture)
concerns: No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent framework experience
AI/GenAI exposure is ~1 year, far short of the required 8+ years of AI-driven solution development
Python not listed; cloud experience is application-level (AWS CDK) rather than designing AI systems on cloud platforms

key_factors.factor: Senior engineering breadth and TypeScript/Node expertise
